Interface AmwpClientListener

All Known Implementing Classes:
AetherisNotebookPanel, SshClientApp.UserFrameListener
public interface AmwpClientListener
The AmwpClientListener interface is the set of callbacks the shell client receives. A callback runs off the Swing event thread. The event thread is the thread that paints the window. Scope A is channel A, the value AmwpConstants.CHANNEL_A. // @aa-sdd G-07 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

    • onAmwpClosed

      void onAmwpClosed(String reason)
      The method reports that the framed channel dropped back to raw bytes or closed. The call runs off the Swing event thread.
      Parameters:
      reason - The reason is the text that explains the close.

    • onConsoleModel

      void onConsoleModel(String model, String think)
      The method reports that the console asked for the model settings. The call runs off the Swing event thread.
      Parameters:
      model - The model is the Ollama id from the shell, and it is empty when the shell has none.
      think - The think value is empty when thinking is off, true when thinking is on, and otherwise the level.
